historical_window.date_basis: Use only a listing commit at/before each opening cut. First named daily price revisions, retrospective event checks and later backfill checks are separate evidence.

exact_join_crosscheck.scope: Exact join to fixed 3,170 starting strings. All instrument types and the 462 unmatched filer strings retained. The reported day bar is available only retrospectively.

listings.session_policy: Prior or equal committer timestamp at each 14:30 UTC core open, expected weekdays except January 17. Commit time is a proxy for public availability, not source capture or exchange effective time. February 1 excluded from every January open.

baseline.instrument_type_eligibility: All baseline strings are retained as a coverage denominator. Presence does not establish common-stock eligibility.

post_window_only.reason: Published after Jan 31 close. Excluded from period arithmetic.

retrospective_event_crosschecks.kind: cash merger for ordinary eligible public shares
stock merger, cash in lieu of fractional shares

source_docs_and_reuse.current_dataset_license: CC BY-SA 4.0 as recorded in LICENSE.md in the 2026 revision; upstream feed rights and historical license at the 2022 vintages unverified. Underlying data omitted.

license_response.sql: SELECT doc_name,doc_text FROM dolt_docs AS OF 'a920rg5v62oo9g91m78c57vvgp149k4u' WHERE doc_name='LICENSE.md'

source_docs_and_reuse.upstream_price_vendor_and_adjustment_con: Unverified for this historical vintage. Treat open as the reported daily bar field. Its raw, unadjusted status, opening auction/regular session rules, exchange venue and exact time of the print were not established.

request_policy.per_session_query_template: SELECT LEFT(act_symbol,1) AS initial, COUNT(*) AS n, JSON_ARRAYAGG(JSON_ARRAY(act_symbol,open,high,low,close,volume)) AS bars FROM ohlcv AS OF '{dolt_commit}' WHERE date = '{session}' GROUP BY LEFT(act_symbol,1) ORDER BY initial
request_policy.checks: Successful response required. Unpack each JSON group, require count to equal the number of bar rows, and verify unique symbol keys. Use exact source spelling without rewriting punctuation. Coherent OHLC means all four positive, finite prices and both open and close within the inclusive low-high range, with strictly positive integer volume for the valid-bar count.

histories.session_wise_vintages: Named OHLCV update for each target session. All 20 commit timestamps fall on the next calendar date. Database commit times and source data arrival at the exchange are distinct. No dissemination or receipt timestamp was inferred.
histories.symbol_sample: All 3,170 starting listing strings include unknown and non-common instruments. Pure row coverage, including all previously unmatched.

daily_ohlcv.fingerprint_rule: Each session materializes ohlcv AS OF its dated initial update commit. Raw SHA-256 identifies returned JSON; semantic SHA-256 hashes sorted [symbol,open,high,low,close,volume] rows encoded by Python json.dumps with compact separators. Raw wrapper/group order can vary.

action_visibility_checks.SLG_split: Absent on both Jan-25 and Feb-1 OHLCV commits, present at the split update on Feb-1. The ex-date was Jan 24. Do not backdate the source record to the ex-date.
action_visibility_checks.DDS_special: Absent in both November–December 2021 symbol-specific dividend queries (Feb 2022 and Nov 2026 revisions). Only the December 30 $0.20 record appeared.
action_visibility_checks.dividend_coverage: 0 January ex-date rows at Feb 1 split-update revision, 928 at Feb 3 dividend-update revision; of the latter, 497 are exact starting-symbol matches. The absence of an ex-date record does not demonstrate no dividend. These timestamps are source commits only.

selected_exit_and_split_checks.selected_cases_rule: Two diagnostic examples deliberately selected from January Form 25 notices in the SEC quarterly index: one cash deal and one common-stock conversion. No estimate of coverage across all January exits.

CSPR.terms: gross, without interest, subject to withholding; exemptions in the issuer filing

selected_exit_and_split_checks.note: No filing was made available at the January 1 snapshot as evidence of a later closing. The two class cover filings preceded that snapshot. January issuer filings establish completion and NYSE notices confirm suspension. These are accounting checks, not trades, terminal execution prices, or evidence of settled cash. Settlement unavailable for both.
